page_note: This page is dominantly substrate teaching: it closes one cosmological unit (judgment-of-recompense via stars/spheres; building of the New Aeon by the First Architect) and opens chapter 46 'Concerning the Four [Great Works]', which sets out a four-fold distribution of the archonic host (ten firmaments / eight earths and four places of Darkness / preparations and strongholds / sphere of stars). The mappings are strictly cosmos→cosmos throughout — astronomical structure, cosmic geography, the four-fold enumeration. Only the chapter-number markers and the formulaic 'Once again the Illuminator said' constitute editorial overlay. The seam flag at i=15 correctly identifies the Mani-attribution wrapper; stripping that wrapper leaves the cosmological question/statement intact. The manichaean_ecclesial=300 flag at i=11 is a false positive — 'of the new' completes 'Aeon of the new' from the prior segment, a cosmological referent, not an ecclesial one. Substantial damage (32.4%) in restoration zones, but enumeration spine ('First kind / Second kind / Third kind / Fourth kind') is preserved.
